turns.assessment: svc109 failed with the t=720 event, not the earlier S14–S04 amplifier incident. At that time trx.och19.z at S02 raised EQPT_TX_FAIL and its far-end receiver trx.och19.a at S03 simultaneously raised OCH_LOS; other services using the same S02–S03 lightpath failed or switched to protection. The S02–S03 amplifiers and channel monitoring showed no change, strongly localizing the cause to the S02 transmitter.

proposals.rationale: The S02 muxponder reported EQPT_TX_FAIL exactly when the far-end S03 interface lost the optical channel. This is the documented signature of a failed transmit laser, while unchanged S02–S03 line-plant telemetry argues against a span or amplifier fault.

A broader card failure could also remove the transmitted channel, but the explicit transmitter-failure alarm and continued valid receive-side monitoring at the S02 unit favor an isolated transmit-laser failure.
